description: Multi-Family Residential Building – Hourly Energy and IEQ Monitoring Time Series - Bolzano area, Italy (2006–2009) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marco Castagna (EURAC research). This dataset contains three years of hourly monitored data from a multi-family residential building located in the Bolzano area, South Tyrol, Italy (46°N, Alpine climate). Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
